notes: Read all 129 source lines before editing. Imports L1-2 (react forwardRef/useCallback/useId/useMemo + @/lib/cn) were replaced: cn -> StyleSheet arrays; forwardRef/useCallback/useId/useMemo kept, and useEffect/useImperativeHandle/useRef/useState added for the measured-track drag machine that stands in for the browser's native <input type=range>.

SliderProps L4-34 ported verbatim by name + JSDoc: value (L6), min (L8), max (L10), step?=1 (L12), onChange (L14), label (L16), formatValue? (L22), showLabel?=true (L27), disabled? (L29), id? (L31). The `className` (L33) Tailwind wrapper class has no RN analog and is kept as an inert web-parity no-op (aliased `_className`); a native `style` override of the outer container + a `testID` test hook replace it. The unit-aware formatValue JSDoc (L17-21) and showLabel JSDoc (L23-26) are carried over.

Component JSDoc L36-53 (input-range wrapping, the full APG keyboard pattern Arrow/Page/Home/End, browser touch+drag, formatValue -> aria-valuetext while aria-valuenow keeps the raw number, md <Input>/<Select> alignment) ported and adapted: since RN has no range input + no slider dependency, the keyboard pattern is reproduced through accessibility actions and the touch+drag through a PanResponder, both documented in the file header.

forwardRef<HTMLInputElement,SliderProps> L54 -> forwardRef<View,SliderProps>; the destructure L55-68 is preserved (value,min,max,step=1,onChange,label,formatValue,showLabel=true,disabled,id) with className aliased to _className and style/testID added. step default 1 (L59) and showLabel default true (L63) kept.
reactId=useId() L70 + inputId = id ?? `slider-${reactId}` L71 preserved 1:1; inputId is applied as nativeID on the track View (the web set it as the <input id> the <label htmlFor> pointed at).

display useMemo L73-76 ported character-for-character: formatValue ? formatValue(value) : String(value), deps [formatValue, value]. It feeds both the visible readout and accessibilityValue.text (web aria-valuetext L116).

handleChange L78-84 (Number(e.currentTarget.value), skip Number.isNaN, else onChange) -> a stable `commit(next)` that skips null/NaN AND skips when next === current value (the browser fires no change event for an identical value), then calls onChange. It is shared by the drag and every accessibility action so the onChange contract is identical across all input paths.

The web <input type=range> element L105-123 (min/max/step/value/disabled/onChange) has no RN primitive and no @react-native-community/slider dependency exists, so it is rebuilt: a track View carries a PanResponder (onPanResponderGrant/Move map the absolute touch X to a snapped value via the measured track width + left edge, the native equivalent of the browser owning the pointer during a range drag) plus an onLayout that records the width/left (measureInWindow). disabled gates the responder via onStart/MoveShouldSetPanResponder=!disabled. snapToStep reproduces the input's step snapping + min/max clamp with a step<=0 -> 1 guard matching the browser's coercion.

The browser-supplied keyboard pattern documented in the JSDoc (L40-43: Arrow=step, Page=~10% of range, Home/End=min/max) is reproduced as accessibilityRole='adjustable' + accessibilityActions: increment/decrement (Arrow +/- step), pageUp/pageDown (Math.max(step, range/10), i.e. ~10% but at least one step), and minimum/maximum (Home/End -> min/max). onAccessibilityAction runs each branch through the same commit(), and is a no-op when disabled.

aria-valuetext={display} L116 -> accessibilityValue.text; aria-valuenow (implicit in the input's value) -> accessibilityValue.now=value; min/max -> accessibilityValue.min/max. aria-label={showLabel ? undefined : label} L115: RN cannot express the web <label htmlFor> association, so the accessible name is always carried via accessibilityLabel=label on the adjustable (covering both the showLabel association and the !showLabel aria-label); the visible label row is still rendered only when showLabel, matching the layout. accessibilityState.disabled mirrors the input `disabled`.

Layout L86-125 ported: the space-y-1 wrapper (L87, + className) -> styles.container (gap 4) + the caller style override; the showLabel label row (L88-100: flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2, <label> text-sm font-medium --text-secondary, readout <span> text-xs --text-muted tabular-nums) -> a labelRow View (row/baseline/space-between/gap 8) with AppText tone='secondary' fontSize14 fontWeight500 + AppText tone='muted' fontSize12; the h-9 track wrapper (L101-104) -> styles.trackRow (height 36, centered); the h-2 w-full rounded-full bg --glass-border input track -> styles.track (height 8, borderRadius 9999, colors.border) with an accent-cyan-500 fill View (width = fraction*trackWidth) and a thumb View (left = fraction position, vertically centered on the 8px track). fill/thumb positions live in memoised style objects so no inline literal hits the lint gate.

Native-safe adaptations documented in-file + here: <input type=range> -> PanResponder over a measured View (no slider dep); APG keyboard pattern -> accessibility increment/decrement/pageUp/pageDown/minimum/maximum actions; aria-valuetext/valuenow -> accessibilityValue.text/now; <label htmlFor> association -> always-on accessibilityLabel; Tailwind (space-y-1/h-2/h-9/rounded-full/accent-cyan-500/disabled:opacity-50/tabular-nums/focus-visible ring/cursor-pointer) -> StyleSheet tokens (--glass-border track, accent fill, opacity 0.5 disabled); focus-visible ring + cursor + tabular-nums dropped (no RN analog) with intent preserved; className -> inert no-op + style override. No DOM <input>/<div>/<label>/<span>, no cn(), no recharts/leaflet/framer-motion, and no web @/components/ui imports remain.
